description.en:
Specifies whether the application is common. Valid values:

- **1**: common

- **0**: not common

- If you omit this parameter (the default), all applications are returned.

title.zh: 批量查询访问控制应用

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit

The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 10 requests per second. Calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which may impact your business.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-acl-apps --lang zh --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --acl-type VPC --popular 1 --protocols TCP --region cn-hangzhou
